lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, extending towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Approximately ten vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a lattice structure where spots are positioned as nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 18 discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the fin's silhouette, with a higher concentration observed in the posterior and distal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a dense field of small, high-luminance spots, significantly smaller and more numerous than those on the lateral flank.
